title: Modified Pivotal Response Treatment for Insistence on Sameness in Autistic Youth
official: Modified Pivotal Response Treatment for Insistence on Sameness in Autistic Youth
summary: The purpose of this open label trial is to examine the preliminary feasibility, acceptability, and effectiveness of a 12-week behavioral intervention program (1 hour/week) to treat insistence on sameness (e.g., difficulty tolerating changes in routine) in youth with autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Treatment will be delivered via secure telemedicine platform and consist of a combination of parent-training and parent-mediated intervention with the child.
